key_concepts: Motion is described by distance travelled and time of travel
Distance is the measure of change in position from a reference point
Distance is measured with a ruler or meterstick
The standard metric unit of distance is the meter
Metric prefixes such as kilo, deci, centi, and milli indicate longer or shorter distances
Common distance conversions include 1 km = 1000 m and 1 m = 100 cm
Time is the duration in which things happen and is expressed in seconds, minutes, or hours
Common time conversions include 1 hour = 60 minutes and 1 minute = 60 seconds
The distance covered by a moving object is affected by its speed
In a given time, a faster object covers greater distance and a slower object covers less d
Speed is calculated by dividing distance by time
Speed is measured in meters per second or kilometers per hour
